fields.description:
## Symptom

Three repo gates are enforced by pytest but not by `make lint`, so the documented local
pre-flight returns green on a tree CI rejects:

| gate | how it surfaced |
|---|---|
| `tests/unit/test_mechanism_delta.py` | change 2601 pushed red; `make lint` exit 0 |
| `tests/unit/test_predates_gate_guard_parity.py` | change 2600 pushed red |
| `tests/unit/test_api_surface_gate.py` | change 2609 pushed red; `make lint` exit 0 |

All three fired on 2026-09-04 on changes whose authors had run `make lint` and
`make typecheck` and seen them pass. The defect is the CONTRACT, not the placement: a
proxy that returns green on a tree CI will reject turns "I verified locally" into a false
statement made in good faith.

A survey (recorded in a ticket comment) puts the pytest-only repo-invariant class at
roughly seventy modules -- ratchets, baselines, public-surface censuses, workflow-parity
checks, docs/registry drift gates, whole-tree AST policy scans. Any curated subset of that
is a second list to keep in sync -- the same drift defect one level up.

## Approach

Do not curate. `make test` is `pytest -m "not integration and not external"`, which is
EXACTLY the selection CI's gating cell runs: `DEFAULT_SUITE_MARKS`
(`.github/workflows/_build-and-test.yml:811`) is matrix-conditional, and the
`ubuntu-latest, py3.13` cell -- the one that also collects coverage -- resolves to that
same string. The other two Ubuntu cells run a strict subset of it
(`... and not repo_policy`) and macOS runs the `platform_compat` subset, so `make test` is
a superset of every cell and an exact match for the gating one.

1. **New `make verify` = `lint typecheck test`** -- named in AGENTS.md as THE pre-push
   contract. Complete by construction: no curated list, no new selection mechanism,
   nothing to drift. A Makefile target is not a `ci_gate` under the mechanism scanner
   (that kind is `scripts/check_*.py` files and workflow `run:` steps), so no mechanism is
   added.
2. **`make lint`, `make typecheck` and `.pre-commit-config.yaml` are untouched.** They
   stay the fast commit gate; commit-time cost is unchanged.
3. **No new fast-tier name is minted; the existing one is corrected.** `make check` is
   ALREADY lint + typecheck, and its help text ("Run every check-only gate (no mutation)")
   is part of how the false green got its authority. It is reworded to say plainly that it
   is the tight-loop subset and that `make verify` is what must pass before pushing.
   Adding a THIRD name would build a menu, and a menu invites picking the cheap item;
   deleting a false claim from a target that already exists shrinks the surface instead.
4. **`make test` gains `-n $(PYTEST_WORKERS) --dist worksteal`, `PYTEST_WORKERS ?= 4`.**
   CI runs the suite under xdist and local runs it serially -- itself a local/CI
   divergence of the kind this bug is about, and the reason a full local suite is slow
   enough that nobody runs it. 4 is CI's own ubuntu pin AND the value
   `docs/coverage.md:42-47` already tells contributors to use locally; the repo has an
   explicit reasoned decision AGAINST `-n auto` (it "over-subscribes on larger local
   hosts", `_build-and-test.yml:780`), which a measurement on this host confirms. So this
   aligns `make test` with existing repo guidance rather than inventing a value.
5. **The cost is documented wherever the command is named** -- `make verify`'s help text,
   AGENTS.md, `docs/local-dev-env.md`. A contributor who expects `make lint`'s ~27 s and
   gets minutes will kill it and stop trusting the target, and a contract nobody runs
   fails as badly as a green that lies.

### Consumers of `make test`'s current serial behaviour

Enumerated so none is left stale by item 4:
- `docs/local-dev-env.md:466` ("Day-to-day gates" block) -- UPDATED: gains `make verify`
  and states the scheduler and the measured cost.
- `docs/local-dev-env.md:470-483` (per-test hang budget) -- reviewed, deliberately left:
  it contrasts CI's coverage tracing and tier breadth against a local run and already
  quotes `-n 4 --dist worksteal` as CI's shape, so `make test` matching that shape makes
  the passage more accurate, not less.
- `docs/coverage.md:36-47` -- UPDATED with one sentence noting `make test` now runs that
  scheduler by default, so the hand-written invocation and the target no longer differ.

## AC3 -- the `git add` skew

`test_predates_gate_guard_parity._tracked_paths()` runs `git ls-files scripts tests docs
.github`, so it cannot see a gate file written but not yet staged: the gate reports green
before `git add` and red after, on the same working tree. It becomes `git ls-files
--cached --others --exclude-standard`, i.e. the tree as CI will see it once committed.
Strictly widening -- every path it adds is one MORE step that must carry a guard -- so it
can only turn a false green red, never the reverse.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [x] `make verify` exists and runs `lint`, `typecheck` and `test`.
- [x] `make verify`'s help text states its measured wall-clock cost, so the cost is visible
      from `make help` without reading any document.
- [x] `make lint`, `make typecheck` and `.pre-commit-config.yaml` are unchanged in scope.
- [x] `make check`'s help text no longer claims to run every check-only gate, and points
      at `make verify`.
- [x] `make test` runs under `-n $(PYTEST_WORKERS) --dist worksteal` with
      `PYTEST_WORKERS ?= 4`, overridable on the command line.
- [x] Introducing a violation of each of the three named gates in turn makes `make verify`
      fail while `make lint` still exits 0; the three RED runs are quoted on the ticket.
- [x] `_tracked_paths()` includes untracked, non-ignored paths, so the parity gate's
      verdict does not change when a new gate file is `git add`ed; a new regression test
      pins that a written-but-unstaged path is seen.
- [x] AGENTS.md names `make verify` as the pre-push contract, `make lint` as the
      commit-time gate, says why `make lint` alone is insufficient, and states the cost.
- [x] `docs/local-dev-env.md` and `docs/coverage.md` agree with the new `make test`
      scheduler; the "Day-to-day gates" block lists `make verify` with its cost.
- [x] `make verify` needs no CI provider -- make + ruff + mypy + pytest over the checkout
      only (`project.portability`).

## Testing

Every command is run from this change's own worktree with its venv first on `PATH`
(`env PATH="$PWD/.venv/bin:$PATH" <cmd>`).

- `make lint` -- the unchanged commit gate is clean, and neither the complexity nor the
  mechanism-delta ratchet fires on this change.
- `make typecheck` -- mypy over `src/rebar` and `scripts/`.
- `make verify` -- the new contract end to end on a clean tree, timed with `time`: passes;
  the measured figure is what the help text and the docs quote.
- `pytest tests/unit/test_predates_gate_guard_parity.py` -- the AC3 fix and its new
  regression test.
- Three RED demonstrations, each reverted immediately after, output quoted on the ticket:
  1. add a stale entry to `.github/mechanism-baseline.json` -> `make verify` fails in
     `test_mechanism_delta.py` while `make lint` still exits 0;
  2. drop one `[ -f ... ]` guard in `.github/workflows/_build-and-test.yml` ->
     `make verify` fails in `test_predates_gate_guard_parity.py`;
  3. add a symbol to `rebar.__all__` -> `make verify` fails in `test_api_surface_gate.py`
     while `make lint` still exits 0.
- The `git add` skew demonstration: write a new unguarded gate-script reference and run
  the parity test before and after `git add` -- the verdict is identical in both states
  (on `main` it differs).

## File impact

`Makefile` (`verify`, `check` help text, `test` scheduler), `AGENTS.md`,
`docs/local-dev-env.md`, `docs/coverage.md`,
`tests/unit/test_predates_gate_guard_parity.py`.
